title: Agrobacterium tumefaciens GV3101 (ATG): An Emerging Green Biosorbent for High-Efficiency Hg(II) Capture from Contaminated Wastewater
content:

DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00534E, Paper

The growing interest in microbial adsorbents for heavy metal remediation arises from their inherent safety, efficiency, and environmental compatibility. In this study, isolates of Agrobacterium tumefaciens GV3101 (ATG) were selected...
